text: `InitDefaultCompletionCmd` adds a `completion` command that generates shell-completion scripts, unless completion was disabled, the command has no subcommands, or a command/alias named `completion` already exists. The generated command uses `NoArgs`, `NoFileCompletions`, configurable visibility/grouping, and optional description handling (`completions.go:678-715`; constants at `completions.go:96-102`).
